title: Local two-process harness: transit + reader against shared IPFS
description: Write a test harness (Rust integration test or shell script) that starts one transit instance and one reader instance, both pointing at the same rust-ipfs node and SQLite stores. Post an article through the reader POST command; verify it appears via ARTICLE, GROUP, and OVER. Why: this is the minimal smoke test proving the two binaries interoperate.
